title: AITA for ignoring a homeless person who wanted money
question: AITA for ignoring a homeless person who wanted money
body:
So just for some context, I work in a big city with a fairly large homeless population. I’m usually accosted by them every day for money/food/etc and recognize plenty of them. I’ve been receptive to them before, but after multiple incidents personally and that I’ve witness, I choose to either ignore or engage, since I don’t know if they would be aggressive or not. 

So, me and my boyfriend are waiting in the train station for my train to arrive, and a clear homeless man is personally going up to every person he sees trying to get food. Me, seeing this as he approaches me, I wave him off and grab my boyfriend closer to me, as I feel uncomfy. The homeless man proceeded to personally say to me “fuck you” so forth and so on. Then proceeds the typical back and forth between him, my boyfriend and I, which causes my temper to come out. 

Afterwards, my boyfriend is having a debate with me now about what I did was wrong, and I made him feel less than “human” in a sense. My reasoning is that I don’t want to get us involved, as I have to many incidents where once I talk, they latch on and try convincing me to give money. 

So what’s the verdict reddit?
